title: Analysis of glucosylceramide from plasma and cerebrospinal fluid
author: David A Priestman
materials: Allow to cool to Room temperature .
Pre-equilibrate 50 mg Discovery® DPA-6S SPE Tube (supplied by Sigma-Aldrich) with: 1 mL acetonitrile 2 x 1 mL water 2 x 1 mL acetonitrile

steps.title: Prepare extraction mixture
steps.instruction: Pipette 25 µL plasma or cerebrospinal fluid into a 1.5 mL screw‑cap tube, add 175 µL de‑ionised water to bring the volume to 200 µL, then add 0.8 mL chloroform/methanol (1:2, v/v) to obtain a final chloroform : methanol : water ratio of 4 : 8 : 3. Vortex briefly.

steps.title: Add PBS and chloroform
steps.instruction: Add 0.2 mL phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) followed by 0.2 mL chloroform to the tube and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect lower phase
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 16 000 × g for 10 min at room temperature. Carefully transfer the lower (organic) phase to a new tube while retaining the upper aqueous phase.

steps.title: Dry and re‑suspend lower phase
steps.instruction: Dry the collected lower phase under a stream of oxygen‑free nitrogen in a heating block set to 42 °C. When dry, re‑suspend in 20 µL chloroform/methanol (1:3), add the retained upper phase, and vortex.

steps.title: Pre‑equilibrate C18 column
steps.instruction: Condition each Telos C18 column (Kinesis, UK) with four 1 mL washes of methanol followed by three 1 mL washes of de‑ionised water.

steps.title: Load sample onto C18 column
steps.instruction: Apply the lower/upper phase mixture onto the equilibrated C18 column and allow it to drip through by gravity flow.

steps.title: Wash C18 column
steps.instruction: Rinse the original sample tube with 1 mL water and pass this wash onto the column, then wash the column three times with 1 mL de‑ionised water each.

steps.title: Elute GSLs
steps.instruction: Elute glycospingolipids with 2 mL chloroform/methanol (98:2); first push through 0.5 mL using a syringe adapter, then collect the remaining eluate in a new tube.

steps.title: Post‑elution vortex and storage
steps.instruction: Vortex the eluate and either store it overnight at 4 °C or proceed directly to enzymatic digestion.

steps.title: Dry eluate and concentrate
steps.instruction: Vortex the 5 mL C18 eluate, dry under nitrogen at 42 °C until approximately 150 µL remains, transfer to a 1.5 mL screw‑cap tube, rinse the original tube with 200 µL chloroform/methanol (2:1), vortex and combine with the main eluate, then dry the combined volume under a slow nitrogen stream at 42 °C.

steps.title: Final re‑suspension before digestion
steps.instruction: Re‑suspend the dried residue in 10 µL chloroform/methanol (2:1), vortex, and dry again under a very slow nitrogen stream, ensuring that all liquid is removed from the bottom of the tube.

steps.title: Add Cerezyme digestion mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL digestion mix per sample by combining 15 µL Cerezyme® (stored at 4 °C) with 10 µL buffer (0.6 % Triton in 50 mM sodium acetate, pH 5.2, stored at 4 °C); add this mixture to each sample and vortex.

steps.title: Incubate digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 72 hours.

steps.title: Prepare labelling mix
steps.instruction: Dissolve 2‑aminoanthranilic acid (2AA) to 30 mg mL⁻¹ in labelling buffer (4 % sodium acetate trihydrate, 2 % boric acid in methanol) with vortexing, then add sodium cyanoborohydride to a final concentration of 45 mg mL⁻¹ and vortex (handle cyanoborohydride with care, consult SDS).

steps.title: Label glycans
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the labelling mix to the 25 µL digested sample in the screw‑cap tube, vortex, and incubate in an oven at 80 °C for 1 hour, vortexing again at the 30‑minute mark.

steps.title: Prepare for SPE
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL acetonitrile:water (97:3) to the labelled reaction, then transfer 1.2 mL to an equilibrated DPA‑6S solid‑phase extraction column and allow it to drip through by gravity.

steps.title: Wash DPA‑6S column
steps.instruction: Wash the column twice with 1 mL acetonitrile:water (95:5) each (first by adding to a 1.5 mL tube then applying to the column, second by directly adding 1 mL onto the column).

steps.title: Elute labelled oligosaccharides
steps.instruction: Elute the glycans with 1 mL water into a clean tube.

steps.title: Final sample cleanup
steps.instruction: Rinse the original sample tube with 200 µL chloroform, vortex and combine with the eluate, then sequentially re‑suspend in 200 µL, 100 µL, and finally 30 µL chloroform/methanol (2:1), vortexing and drying under a very slow nitrogen stream after each step.

steps.title: Prepare injection mixture
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of the final dried sample to 140 µL acetonitrile (total 200 µL), vortex, and transfer to HPLC vials.

steps.title: Store eluate
steps.instruction: Store the DPA‑6S eluate at –20 °C until analysis.

steps.title: Set up HPLC
steps.instruction: Configure a Waters Alliance 2695 system with an in‑line Waters 2475 multi‑λ fluorescence detector (Ex 360 nm, Em 425 nm) and a 4.6 × 250 mm TSK gel‑Amide 80 column maintained at 30 °C. Set flow rate to 0.8 mL min⁻¹, run time 60 min (total run 35 min), and use the normal‑phase gradient described by Neville et al. (2004). Mobile phase A = acetonitrile, B = de‑ionised water, C = 100 mM ammonium acetate, pH 3.85.

steps.title: Inject calibration standard
steps.instruction: Inject a calibration standard containing 2.5 pmol 2AA‑labelled chitotriose (Ludger) with each sample set to enable molar quantification from peak integrals.
